cycle.description: Optional cycle to create within the release

isArchived.description: Whether the cycle is archived (default: false)

isLocked.description: Whether the cycle is locked (default: false)

name.description: Cycle name (required if cycle is provided)

projectKey.description: Project key - unique identifier for the project

projectID.description: Project ID (optional, can be auto-resolved from project key if not provided)

startDate.description: Release start date in format DD-MM-YYYY or MM-DD-YYYY (depends on QMetry instance date format configuration)

targetDate.description: Release target/end date in format DD-MM-YYYY or MM-DD-YYYY (depends on QMetry instance date format configuration)

name: qmetry_create_release
title: QMetry: Create Release
